name: neutral-light
description: Default preset. Warm off-white ground, one blue accent, IBM Plex. For client pitches, internal updates, printed handouts and any audience that reads in a lit room.

reasons.font: IBM Plex reads as technical and institutional without being the default AI pick; it has a matching mono for numbers.
reasons.accent: One blue, used only for the slide's key number, the active step or the section index.
reasons.noDecor: No grid, no tracked capitals, no ghost numerals: nothing on the slide that does not carry information.
